label: The Multisystem Specialist
tagline: A stable cube on a visible grid — the engine as small instance of a pattern.
cluster_explainer: The Auditor cluster wants the engine to remain unfinished and legible — it leaves forever the moment the seams are hidden.
demo_highlights: Cube is the most general primitive — no domain-specific curves, legible as 'shape' rather than as 'music' or 'video'
Grid preset keeps the coordinate system visible so the architecture can be mapped onto any other cross-domain pattern
Mid-band reactance tracks the body of the signal where cross-domain translation actually happens — not the extremes
Hold envelope preserves state across reconfigurations: switching versions shows what changes and what does not, the seams between modules stay visible
Muted teal refuses to look like a music tool — the demo reads as a small instance of a larger pattern, which is exactly what the typology wants to map
